responses.text:
The thread is titled "IndieBoard · Best mechanical keyboard switches" ([IndieBoard thread](https://forum.unsupported.example/threads/991)). I read only the first 20,000 of 38,123 characters of the saved file, so I can't say what the rest covers.

In that part, every post (member1 through about member134, all dated 2026-11-10) uses the same sentence: "For daily office coding I switched to [switch] ([N]g springs) — quieter bottom-out and less finger fatigue." Four switches rotate through the posts:

- Boba U4T tactile
- Cherry MX Silent Red
- Gateron Oil King linear
- Topre 45g electro-capacitive

Spring weights cycle between 55g and 69g. The posts give no testing, comparisons, or reasons beyond "quieter" and "less fatigue," and the wording barely changes. That pattern suggests templated or automated posts rather than real discussion, so I'd treat the content as unverified. The site has no reading tool here, so I haven't checked other threads.
